column1: # The Lumen icon set (apps/core/lumen-icons): one row per icon, generated by tools/icons/gen_icons.py from Material
# Symbols Rounded, weight 400, grade 0, optical size 24 (Apache-2.0, pinned commit in gen_icons.py).
# Columns: our name (res/drawable/lumen_ic_<name>.xml), the Material Symbols name, fill (0 outline, 1 filled), sha256
# of the source SVG at the pinned commit, what it means on screen. Filled only where the stock pattern is filled:
# a checked radio button, a checked box, a switch that is on, play and pause in a player, done and failed marks.
